title: ClearPath Tier Schedule for the Staged Rush Charge
content:
The staged rush charge on a Hardware Procurement staged re-quote of a cancelled endpoint line is owed only when the cancelled order was quoted with rush. It is nothing for a client whose active ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement is on the ClearPath Premier or ClearPath Enterprise tier, **75.00 USD** when that active agreement is on the ClearPath Standard or ClearPath Professional tier, and **150.00 USD** for every other client.

| Cancelled order quoted with rush | Client's ClearPath position | Staged rush charge |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | active, ClearPath Premier or ClearPath Enterprise | nothing |
| Yes | active, ClearPath Standard or ClearPath Professional | 75.00 |
| Yes | active, ClearPath Monitor or ClearPath Essentials | 150.00 |
| Yes | agreement in any other status, or no agreement | 150.00 |
| No | any | not owed |

The tier and status are those on the client's ClearPath agreement record; a closed ClearPath Enterprise agreement is not an active one and leaves the client at 150.00.
